notes: Your details are now yours to change from the Profile tab, and each line says what tapping it will do: Add fills in anything still blank and saves at once; Edit is for the details you can change yourself once a day — phone, gender, marital status, date of birth, marriage anniversary and your addresses; Request is everything else (name, login email, bank, IDs) and the day's second change to the same detail, which your HR approves. Designation and department are always a request, and the screen shows how many documents you still owe. Asking for a loan or advance now includes the repayment plan: how many months, and which salary month the deduction starts in, with the monthly instalment worked out for you before you submit. The menu has been reorganised to match the web portal exactly — same section names, same wording — and Cash Vouchers, Travel and Tax Declaration have been taken off it. Birthdays and celebrations cover the next 30 days with a See all, wedding anniversaries read as wedding anniversaries, and your CEO/MD's birthdays and the company's own anniversary now appear on the calendar and in the morning digest. Your profile shows the work site you are actually assigned to. An approval decided over your approvers' heads now names the person who made it. This needs the matching server update to be live.
